front.title: Apple's Q4 2026 Earnings Call Takeaways
front.tldr: Apple posted record Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12% year on year, in John Ternus' first earnings call as chief executive. iPhone revenue grew 17.5% despite ongoing iPhone Duo shortages.

front.title: Antonelli: I couldn't see through my tears on title-clinching lap
front.tldr: Kimi Antonelli, 20, became Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion at the Mexican Grand Prix and said he was crying so hard before the finish he could barely see the track.

front.title: Readwise takes on Amazon's Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
front.tldr: Readwise launched Readwise Books, an e-book store and reading app combining purchases, tracking and AI features, to challenge Amazon's Kindle and Goodreads ecosystem.

stories.title: llm 0.37
stories.tldr: Simon Willison shipped version 0.37 of his open-source LLM command-line tool and Python library, adding support for new models after two months of accumulated fixes and features.

stories.title: Anthropic warns that it's very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
stories.tldr: Anthropic said it is nearing recursive self-improvement, the point where AI becomes skilled enough at training itself to sharply accelerate its own capabilities.

stories.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can 'predict human behavior'
stories.tldr: Startup 42AI emerged from stealth with $62.5 million in funding and a world model it says can predict human behaviour before people act.

stories.title: Y Combinator's Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
stories.tldr: Y Combinator's Garry Tan said he spends as much as $200,000 a year on AI tokens, running agents so constantly it affects his sleep.

stories.title: Ninja's first-ever microwave just replaced two of my kitchen appliances at once
stories.tldr: Ninja launched its first microwave, the Crispi, pairing microwave speed with FusionCrisp technology that TechCrunch says delivers air-fryer-style crisping in one appliance.

stories.title: Casio's new keyboard lets anyone play along to songs without ever hitting a wrong note
stories.tldr: Casio's new keyboard uses Feel Sync technology to keep beginners in tune while they play along to songs, aiming to make learning less frustrating.

stories.title: This Chinese Android phone brand has launched a Harry Potter collab
stories.tldr: Realme launched a Harry Potter-themed Android phone, with magical packaging and themed accessories designed to turn an everyday device into a collectible.

stories.title: Why some websites are blocking AI agents
stories.tldr: Some websites are blocking AI agents from browsing or buying on their behalf, limiting a tool that can otherwise make routine online tasks faster.

stories.title: Apple to require 18+ age ratings for dating apps and AI romantic companions
stories.tldr: Apple will require stricter 18+ age ratings for apps with dating, location-sharing or AI romantic companion features, starting November 16th for developers to comply.

stories.title: Apple spent a record $45.77 billion on R&D in fiscal 2026, up 32%
stories.tldr: Apple's research and development spending hit an all-time high of $45.77 billion in fiscal 2026, up 32% year over year, as its product roadmap keeps expanding.

stories.title: Siri Classic brings old things back to life
stories.tldr: Six Colors explores why Apple resurrected an old-style Siri as Siri Classic, comparing it to Coca-Cola's return of its original formula after the New Coke backlash.

stories.title: Apple recently notified users in 99 countries of potential mercenary spyware attacks
stories.tldr: Apple warned users across 99 countries that they may have been targeted by mercenary spyware, as German authorities probe reports that lawmakers' phones were hacked.

stories.title: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross to Score David Fincher's 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'
stories.tldr: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross will again score a David Fincher film, teaming up for his new feature The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.

stories.title: Neve Campbell Confirms Return for 'Scream 8'
stories.tldr: Neve Campbell confirmed she will reprise Sidney Prescott in Scream 8, returning after her character survived her latest encounter with the Ghostface killers.

stories.title: 'Mouse' Review: 'Saint Frances' and 'Ghostlight' Filmmakers Bring Their Singular Humanity to a Coming-of-Age Tale
stories.tldr: IndieWire calls Mouse, the third collaboration between filmmakers Kelly O'Sullivan and Alex Thompson, their best yet, praising its humane take on a coming-of-age story.

stories.title: Project Hail Mary Author Andy Weir Has Some Controversial Thoughts On AI
stories.tldr: Project Hail Mary author Andy Weir says he isn't worried about AI, and shared his view on how the technology could end up being used in entertainment.

stories.title: Jayson Tatum named Eastern Conference Player of the Week for 14th time in career
stories.tldr: Jayson Tatum was named Eastern Conference Player of the Week for the 14th time in his career, just two weeks into the Celtics' season.

stories.title: Jayson Tatum shines as Celtics beat Magic, claim fifth straight win: 8 takeaways
stories.tldr: Tatum led the Celtics to a 108-97 road win over Orlando, their fifth straight victory, extending a strong start that follows a 4-1 October.

stories.title: Why Drake Maye's play in Miami was his best game yet this season
stories.tldr: Drake Maye produced his best performance of the season in a comeback win over Miami, with teammates saying his growth this year shows in how he plays under pressure.

stories.title: Game Notes: Patriots Improve to a 3-0 Record in the AFC East
stories.tldr: The Patriots beat the Dolphins 24-19 in Miami on Sunday, moving to 3-0 within the AFC East and 5-3 overall for the season.

stories.title: Tom Brady is set to make his return to Gillette Stadium on Sunday
stories.tldr: Tom Brady will call Sunday's Patriots-Packers game for Fox from Gillette Stadium, his first time back at the ground where he won six Super Bowls.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton goes viral after emotional moment with Peter Bonnington in Mexico
stories.tldr: Footage of Lewis Hamilton congratulating his former race engineer Peter Bonnington, now with champion Kimi Antonelli, went viral after the Mexican Grand Prix.

stories.title: How Mercedes can win the 2026 F1 constructors' championship at the Brazilian GP
stories.tldr: Mercedes can clinch the constructors' championship as early as this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix, a week after Kimi Antonelli sealed the drivers' title in Mexico.

stories.title: Hirakawa scores points on his F1 debut after both Alpine drivers are penalised
stories.tldr: Ryo Hirakawa was promoted to a points finish on his Formula 1 debut after both Alpine drivers picked up penalties in Mexico.

stories.title: Red Sox trio of Ceddanne Rafaela, Wilyer Abreu, Caleb Durbin take home Gold Gloves
stories.tldr: Ceddanne Rafaela, Wilyer Abreu and Caleb Durbin each won Gold Gloves, giving the Red Sox a league-high three winners alongside the Diamondbacks.

stories.title: As MLB free agency begins today, here's a look at the 2026-2027 MLB Offseason Calendar
stories.tldr: MLB free agency opened, giving the Red Sox their exclusive negotiating window with their own free agents five days after the World Series ended.

finally.title: Arkivism is a search and visual discovery engine for millions of public domain works
finally.tldr: Arkivism is a new search and discovery engine for millions of public-domain artworks from the Smithsonian, the Met, NASA, the Library of Congress and more.
